initial_decision.brief_rationale: R290-2 establishes randomized assignment, full compliance, positivity, consistency, and no interference, identifying the causal effect from the population risks. Completion risk is 1/10 under X=1 and 20/40 under X=0, so the average causal risk difference is 0.1 − 0.5 = −0.4.
